rechabite.definition:
n. One of the descendants of Jonadab, the son of Rechab,
   all of whom by his injunction abstained from the use of intoxicating
   drinks and even from planting the vine. Jer. xxxv. 2-19. Also, in
   modern times, a member of a certain society of abstainers from
   alcoholic liquors.
rechabite.translation: n. 绝对禁酒者, 禁酒会员

   alcoholic liquors.
rechabites.translation: (Rechabite 的复数) n.绝对禁酒者, 禁酒会员
